text.description_html:
Acorn AZC207, Equality Kitchen Cabinet Knob

The Equality Kitchen Cabinet Knob will give your kitchen contemporary style. Since it is made of stainless steel, it will match all your stainless steel appliances. The clean lines of this Acorn cabinet knob is sure to add a chic touch to your home. Sophisticated in design, this cabinet handle is a great way to add a cosmopolitan look to any home without looking as sterile as other contemporary design can. This Equality stainless steel cabinet knob is a perfect example of how modern design doesn't have to focus on function rather than form. Available in polished or brushed stainless steel finishes.

Also Available: Matching Kitchen Cabinet Pull

Specifications for the Acorn AZC207 Absolute Zero Collection Equality Kitchen Cabinet Knob:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Length: 1-3/4"
  • Projection: 1-1/16"
  • Width: 1"
  • Available in polished or brushed stainless steel.

Sold Individually
